name: qfd_res_slot_ru-u1-COMMIT
purpose: Slot tile of the qfd_sp_res_ser cluster (TP8 v4b slot 777.6 x 518.4), drawn from the cluster down (tools/qwen_vm_me/res_ser_cluster_fp.py). Same RTL and benches as rh / rs. Outline 216 x 142.56 (util <= 58 %); exact pin plan: N = 552-bit word at a 7-track pitch above the macro, strobes / reset / strap at the E end, clk mid-face; E = conveyor, rd[k] / od[k] interleaved at 2 tracks; S and W pin-free. The closed rs view (259.2 x 172.8) cannot be composed (no channel, abutted stubs short); rt (216 x 129.6) failed the in-flow util line (62.6 %).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_res_slot_tile #(.USE_MACRO(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_me_20261008/ot_qfd_res_tiles.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_me_20261008/ot_qfd_res_path.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: fullshape
bench.note: 8-slot composition (ot_qfd_res_tiles, USE_MACRO=1) exact against the bench queue incl. the fixed 19-cycle conveyor latency
